## Summary

**Provider**: Resend — simple API, good free tier, no infra to run.

**New files**
- `src/lib/email/client.ts` — `sendEmail()`, thin Resend wrapper. Falls back to console logging when `RESEND_API_KEY` is unset/placeholder, so `npm run dev` needs no real credentials.
- `src/lib/email/templates.ts` — HTML+text templates for `welcomeEmail()` and `passwordResetEmail()`.
- `src/lib/email/index.ts` — `sendWelcomeEmail()` / `sendPasswordResetEmail()` convenience wrappers.
- `.env.example` — `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM`, `APP_URL` placeholders.

**Wired into `src/lib/users.ts`**
- `createUser(input)` — new function; pushes the user and sends the welcome email.
- `requestPasswordReset(email)` — looks up the user, generates a random token (1h TTL, in-memory `Map`), emails a reset link. Silently no-ops for unknown emails to avoid account enumeration.
- `validatePasswordResetToken()` / `consumePasswordResetToken()` — token lifecycle helpers, ready for a real "set new password" step once actual auth/password storage exists (there isn't any yet in this scaffold).
- Added `getUserByEmail()` since reset lookup needed it.

**Other changes**
- `.gitignore`: added `!.env.example` so the placeholder file isn't swallowed by the `.env*` rule.
- `README.md`: documents the email setup and `.env.local` step.

Verified `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, and a runtime smoke test (welcome email on create, reset email on known address, silent no-op on unknown address) all pass.

**Note**: this app has no real sign-up UI or auth yet — `createUser`/`requestPasswordReset` are library functions ready to be called from routes once those exist.
